sum: RTB Digital, Inc. develops and operates an enterprise media platform under Roundtable. The company operates through two segments Platform Operations and Fintech Operations. It also enables media brands and journalists to distribute, publish, monetize, and engage with their communities within brand, data, and voice; and provides sports, crypto, and financial news coverage with distribution partners. In addition, the company provides global payment acceptance and disbursement solutions. RTB Digital, Inc. was formerly known as Roundtable Media, Inc. The company is based in Seattle, Washington.
ceo: Mr. James Charles Heckman Jr. (CEO, Director & Founder)
